test_title: PYST 10: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Town M is to the south-west of Town A. Town A is to the west of Town D. Town C is to the north of Town D. Town B is to the west of Town C. Town B is to the north of Town A. What is the position of Town C with respect to Town A?
solution:
1) Town M is to the south-west of Town A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06bd10798958342e03557fc6efe865bfbfb1ba1911f95c72a16e2d61ffcfbb45.png] 

2) Town A is to the west of Town D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54b6389cb6de162538e4ac7c8755876e5d347d1fb7cd2997bb2eef8faf7b6f15.png] 

3) Town C is to the north of Town D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77fdf8b9b9061684f1fdb5dc54fa502b55db85c747910c2f00e9b5c2e6bb54ad.png] 

4) Town B is to the west of Town C. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/480c01a442956732352ef783e6b486b730b6f5f2086681ec9a5b4667dd132504.png] 

5) Town B is to the north of Town A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b68e9c934eea32d70a9b45369c4b8eff8653a1d39b9fbe7ca13af2d8f1e615e.png] 

Combining all step we get this diagram

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b61a41fde4285e0c6bd43abe1409177be2a5b48b1da5bd9e1f6f7dec8761b37.png] 

Hence, we say that position of Town C with respect to Town A is North - East.

Hence, the correct answer is "North - East".
